intents.name: expense_log
intents.reply_template: I'll confirm the expense details before saving.

intents.name: query_total
intents.reply_template: I'll calculate spending for the requested period and category.
examples: What is my total spending of today
How much did I spend on food Monday
What did I spend money on today
Show me my spending this month
How much did I spend last week

intents.name: follow_up
intents.reply_template: I'll carry forward the previous intent and update its slots.

intents.name: spending_summary
intents.reply_template: I'll calculate your saved spending total.
examples: How much money did I spend overall

intents.name: today_report
intents.reply_template: I'll summarize today's expenses and items.
examples: How much did I spend today
What did I spend money on today
How many expenses do I have today
Which things did I spend on today

intents.name: spending_breakdown
intents.reply_template: I'll group your expenses by category.
examples: What are the things I spend money on
What do I spend money on

intents.name: history
intents.reply_template: I'll list the saved expenses in this session.
examples: What are these two logged expenses
Why are there two logged expenses

intents.name: current_expense
intents.reply_template: I'll show the latest saved expense.

intents.name: log_update
intents.reply_template: I can add, edit, or remove a saved expense.
examples: Can you help me update this log
Change a record in my expense log
Can I fix my spending record

intents.name: out_of_scope
intents.reply_template: I can help with expense tracking, but not that request.

intents.name: small_talk
examples: Why would I tell you something
